Vendors

Vendor notes for Cisco, Palo Alto PAN-OS, HP ProCurve, Aruba, Juniper, Arista, Dell, Extreme, and Meraki.

Vendor support — NodeControl Docs

Node Control connects over SSH with Netmiko drivers and its own parsers. This page lists the supported vendors and links to the notes for each one.

Cisco — IOS, IOS-XE, NX-OS — NodeControl Docs

Cisco IOS, IOS-XE, and NX-OS are supported. Cisco ASA is partial. IOS-XR is not. Meraki uses the Dashboard API, not SSH, and has its own page.

Palo Alto PAN-OS — NodeControl Docs

Palo Alto PAN-OS firewalls use paloalto_panos over SSH. Inventory, L3 BGP and OSPF, WAN peers and IPSec tunnels, and Find Device ARP probes are included.

HP ProCurve — NodeControl Docs

HP ProCurve, now Aruba OS-Switch, uses hp_procurve_cli, aliased to aruba_osswitch. Detection and L2 topology use ProCurve parsers for LLDP and the MAC table.

Aruba (CX, OS-Switch) — NodeControl Docs

Aruba has two operating systems. AOS-CX uses aruba_os. OS-Switch, the legacy ProCurve line, uses aruba_osswitch. Node Control treats the two CLIs separately.

Aruba AOS-CX — NodeControl Docs

AOS-CX is its own platform, not ProCurve and not Cisco. Node Control uses SSH and the aruba_os driver. Only AOS-CX 10.x command forms are sent.

Juniper Junos — NodeControl Docs

Juniper Junos switches, routers, and SRX firewalls use the juniper_junos driver. L2 topology uses LLDP. Juniper does not do CDP. L3 topology reads OSPF and BGP.

Arista EOS — NodeControl Docs

Arista EOS uses the arista_eos driver. From 0.9.42, L2 topology uses EOS parsers for LLDP, port-channel members, the default gateway, and spanning tree.

Dell — OS6 and OS10 — NodeControl Docs

Dell OS6 (PowerConnect-style) and OS10 are both supported, with drivers dell_os6 and dell_os10. Detection, inventory, and L2 topology work on both.

Extreme — EXOS and VSP — NodeControl Docs

Extreme EXOS and VSP are both supported, with drivers extreme_exos and extreme_vsp. Detection, inventory, L2 and L3 topology, and Find Device work on both.

Cisco Meraki — NodeControl Docs

Meraki MR, MS, MX, and MV devices use the Dashboard API. Node Control does not SSH to them. Set the API key under Settings, Credentials, Meraki API.
